description: This file defines structures, callback types, and a class for managing Solaris lightweight processes (lwps) on Solaris systems, including functions for controlling lwps, listing modules, and retrieving stack information.

classes.name: google_breakpad::SolarisLwp
classes.description: A class providing support for managing Solaris lwps, including listing lwps, controlling their execution, and retrieving module and stack information.

methods.name: SolarisLwp::SolarisLwp
methods.description: Constructor initializing the SolarisLwp object with a process ID.

methods.name: SolarisLwp::getpid
methods.description: Returns the process ID associated with this SolarisLwp instance.

methods.name: SolarisLwp::ControlAllLwps
methods.description: Controls all lwps in the process, suspending or resuming them.

methods.name: SolarisLwp::GetLwpCount
methods.description: Returns the number of lwps in the process.

methods.name: SolarisLwp::Lwp_iter_all
methods.description: Iterates over all lwps, invoking a callback for each.

methods.name: SolarisLwp::GetModuleCount
methods.description: Returns the count of modules in the process.

methods.name: SolarisLwp::ListModules
methods.description: Lists modules in the process, invoking a callback for each.

methods.name: SolarisLwp::GetLwpStackBottom
methods.description: Retrieves the bottom of the stack for a given stack pointer.

methods.name: SolarisLwp::FindSigContext
methods.description: Finds a signal context on the stack given a signal handler's ebp.

methods.name: SolarisLwp::IsAddressMapped
methods.description: Checks if an address is a valid virtual address.
